news.title: High Bandwidth Memory: What It Is and Why It Matters
news.summary_en: High Bandwidth Memory (HBM) is a critical enabling technology for artificial intelligence. The authors of this paper synthesize analysis of the HBM ecosystem for researchers and policymakers.

news.title: Do Robots Lure Us to War? The Impact of the Robotic Revolution on the Propensity for Armed Conflict
news.summary_en: The author developed a framework to understand the decision space for the use of force in the presence of emerging technology and applied it to autonomous weapons systems.
